open_points.subject: plan_run edge delivery for flow-input edges
open_points.text: The next node is the ready node with the smallest node_id; a node is ready when every input port holds its value: flow inputs delivered along every edge from them — a flow input or output endpoint is the node_id empty string (A05 rule 2) —, constants to their port — a FlowConstant's value is the value_id composition wrote —, and outputs of a concluded succeeded node along every enabled edge.
open_points.other_text: An edge with no guard is enabled once its source concluded succeeded;
open_points.question: Must an unguarded edge from a flow input be enabled immediately, or remain unenablable because its empty-string source is not a node that can conclude succeeded?

open_points.subject: plan_run status for refused runs
open_points.text: a run with any refused_by_owner NodeExecution has status refused and no next node.
open_points.other_text: when nothing waits, succeeded when every node concluded succeeded or skipped_by_guard and failed otherwise, a mapped node whose delivered list is over the ceiling counting as failed.
open_points.question: When a refused_by_owner record exists and nothing waits, must the status be refused or failed?

open_points.subject: plan_run flow output sourced directly from a flow input
open_points.text: RunPlan fields (exact, no others exist): conclusions: tuple[ElementState, ...], edges: tuple[EdgeState, ...], derived: tuple[NodeExecutionDraft, ...], next_node: ReadyNode | None, waiting: tuple[WaitingPoint, ...], outputs: tuple[InputSource, ...], missing_outputs: tuple[MissingOutput, ...], status: RunStatus
open_points.other_text: A flow output's source is formed the same way; an output reached by an edge straight from a flow input is that input's StoredValuesRef (A13 rule 3).
open_points.question: Must the flow output be an InputSource such as a RecordedSource wrapping the StoredValuesRef, or may a StoredValuesRef itself be placed in RunPlan.outputs?
